registeredBefore: any model run on the cohort forcing and before any comparison output was produced or inspected
question: Does surface-passive-advection.v1 driven by HYCOM GOFS 3.1 reanalysis 15 m currents track drogued SVP drifters better than the stationary and initial-velocity-persistence baselines over 24/48/72 h?

cohort.observationProvider: NOAA AOML Global Drifter Program hourly QC (ERDDAP drifter_hourly_qc, CC BY 4.0)
cohort.selection: All drifters reported at 2015-01-05T12:00Z inside 10-50N / 80-20W whose drogue_lost_date is empty or later than 2015-01-08T12:00Z, then the two densest 10x14 degree windows south of 40N (HYCOM native 0.08 degree latitude spacing).

forcing.provider: HYCOM GOFS 3.1 GLBv0.08 expt_53.X reanalysis, 15 m depth, 3-hourly
forcing.depthRationale: SVP drogue is centred at 15 m; comparing a 0 m field with a drogued drifter is a depth mismatch and is excluded by the comparator.
forcing.independence: Provider description: NCODA assimilates satellite altimetry, satellite and in-situ SST, and in-situ T/S profiles. Drifter positions and velocities are not assimilated. Recorded as provider assertion; not independently certified.

excludedByRule: drogue lost before or during window
no exact hourly UTC match at a horizon
model particle not ACTIVE/COMPLETED at horizon

preregisteredCriteria.C1_beatsStationary: median separation at 72 h is smaller than the stationary-baseline median at 72 h
preregisteredCriteria.C2_beatsPersistence: median separation at 72 h is smaller than the initial-velocity-persistence median at 72 h
preregisteredCriteria.C3_sampleFloor: at least 20 eligible tracks with a compared 72 h horizon
preregisteredCriteria.C4_reporting: every excluded track and unavailable horizon is listed with its reason; no track is dropped silently
preregisteredCriteria.verdictRule: PASS only if C1 and C2 and C3 and C4 all hold; otherwise FAIL with the failing criteria named. Thresholds are not to be widened after results are seen.

engineeringReference.note: Absolute error levels are not preregistered as acceptance thresholds; published Lagrangian skill for global reanalysis-driven 72 h drift is typically tens of km. This plan tests skill relative to baselines only.
engineeringReference.holdOut: No tuning is performed on this cohort; the model has no tunable parameters in v1. The cohort is therefore both first-look and held-out. A second period must be used before any parameter is introduced.
